from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashPosition(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents position from one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    beginning_cash: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents at beginning of period")
    ending_cash: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents at end of period")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amounts: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing the cash values")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_positions: list[CashPosition]
